profile.summary: Jensen Hughes is a global consulting and engineering firm. It began in fire protection engineering and also provides accessibility consulting, risk and hazard analysis, process safety and security risk consulting, and emergency management. It was formed in 2014 by the merger of Hughes Associates and Rolf Jensen & Associates.
